preregistration: NONE; exploratory full-corpus descriptive survey after EXP-0023C f/p finding
method: Ordered immediate predecessor/successor context frequency vectors with boundary ^/$; cosine of raw counts; ASCII separate from greedy EVA composites cth ckh cph cfh ch sh
comparisons: 25 ASCII chars -> 300 unordered pairs; 31 glyph-aware units -> 465 pairs, all stored or reproducibly exported by script
result: Top compound pairs (both n>=100): ch/sh 0.973152839, k/t 0.956962554, f/p 0.954148272, cph/cth 0.913487355, l/r 0.904319924; literal f/p 0.952110386 matches EXP-0023C precisely
caution: Single-case q/v cosine about 0.9999 due v frequency=1; weakly represented glyphs must never be interpreted as true substitutions. Pair cosine no sign of identical meaning by itself. No per-section/hand and independent witness controls.
strongest_counterhypotheses: Shared word-position, morphology and gallows constraints
Two EVA letters together represent a single stroke ligature
limitations: Single IVTFF witness, no glyph image direct paleography, 25 lowercase editorial symbols not equivalent to unique photographed glyphs, no decoder, 0/5 decipherment criteria
followup: Preregister within-hand/folio and source-witness heldout matched-frequency pairing/copy-model tests before any equivalence claim

question: Does adding both token position and previous observed 8-state token class yield a practically material out-of-root EVA predictive improvement beyond the best single factor after Currier, word-length and line-length controls?
dataset: Owner-held SHA-256-pinned ZL3b-n.txt v3b (bf5b6d4ac1e3a51b1847a9c388318d609020441ccd56984c901c32b09beccafc), 411671 bytes. Same previously exposed editorial source; no new independent witness.
design: Deterministic 5-fold SHA256 folio-number-root grouped exploratory CV; +P0 all-certain lines >=3 words; f3/f8 excluded; model B0 Currier+wordlen+linelen vs position P, predecessor C, joint H; 8-state q-initial x final y/n/l/other; fixed strength25 hierarchical smoothing; teacher-forced predecessor.
positive_control: Seeded synthetic position+predecessor dependence: joint gain D=+0.154873338 nats/token, PASS software sensitivity.
negative_control: Seeded synthetic uniform iid eight classes: joint D=-0.023959741, PASS expected nonadvantage.
null_model: 99 seeded within-line within-wordlength-bin target permutations preserving each line's target counts by length bin; 0/99 >= observed D, empirical p=0.01, narrow null only.
preregistered_success: D=min(NLL_P,NLL_C)-NLL_H >=0.005 nats/token AND positive both Currier A/B AND null p<=0.05
result: NOT_MET preregistered practical and A/B conjunction despite narrow null p=0.01. H marginally best on pooled EVA-only source; no identification of natural language, cipher, nonlanguage copy/edit or hybrid.
limitations: Single previously explored IVTFF EVA witness; folio-number roots not authenticated physical leaves; no actual language-vs-cipher-vs-mechanical generative benchmark; no independent historical semantics or imagery; no new sealed heldout, section/hand confounding remains. Do not claim 5-gate decipherment.
next: Independent rights-reviewed transcription and validated physical-folio/hand/section controls; matched-complexity competing generators, preregistered before testing.

question: On previously exposed owner-held EVA v3b, does one-step copy/edit with char-bigram resets yield a heldout-root predictive gain against the same innovation model, and does position-dependent copying improve further?
dataset: Owner-held SHA-256-pinned ZL3b-n v3b, 411671 B; previously exposed editorial witness, no independent physical leaves or manuscript images
methods: EXP-0027 same 5 root folds, 1537 +P0 certain lines, 12167 word tokens; L train-fitted alpha .5 char bigram with END, K fixed ROT13 bijective remap, M same B innovation plus one-edit local copy channel with 1 train-estimated global lambda, H same B/edit with 2 train-estimated positional lambdas. Heldout negative log loss of whole words.
positive_control: Seeded 1653 exact copies plus 1550 one-substitution words; M gain +2.027393689 nats/token, PASS
negative_control: Seeded cross-line Currier-group word shuffle; M gain +0.000941589 <= +0.01, PASS
normalization_control: One-edit distribution enumerated on a, ab, aa; sums to 1 and matches independent formula, PASS
null_model: 49 seed-fixed within-line exact-wordlength-bucket permutations; preserves each line word multiset and positional lengths; one null >= observed, upper-tail p=.04. Only this weak null rejected.
preregistered_prediction: M-L gain >= +0.01 pooled nats/whole-word AND positive within Currier A and B AND permutation p<=.05
secondary_prediction: H-M gain >=+0.005 pooled AND positive Currier A and B
result: Primary PASS in already-exposed editorial EVA: L=K 8.799614717, M 8.785527298, M gain +0.014087418; Currier A +0.023946047, B +0.009853581; p=0.04. Secondary NOT_MET: H 8.785507501, H gain +0.000019797 with negative A. 2000 root-bootstrap descriptive M gain 95% range [0.009306210,0.019589158]. No proof historical copying, real language/cipher distinction or decipherment.
limitations: Reuses already exposed single EVA editorial source and EXP-0027 split; no true independent physical-leaf heldout or alternate witnesses, only simple unigram-innovation character bigram and one-edit channel; ROT13 cipher only relabeling and exactly non-identifiable; no semantic or author provenance. Root resampling not a physical leaf CI.
next: Independent rights-reviewed transcript/glyph-aligned physical leaf mapping and section/hand-controlled, matched-complexity generative alternatives. New prereg required.
